Mission.eyebrow: Wowɔe na dɔ le xexeame godoo
Mission.headline: Gbedasi la metrɔna o. Ale si amewo kpɔa nu lae trɔ.
Mission.intro: Míele míaƒe videowo ƒe nudzraɖoƒe kple dɔwɔnuwo gbugbɔm tu tso gɔmeɖoanyi ke, eye míele ƒe geɖe ƒe gɔmeɖeɖedɔ tsɔm ɖo afi siwo amewo ƒoa ƒu ɖo xoxo, kpɔa nu, eye womaa nu.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Film nudzraɖoƒe si me filmwo wode gɔme ɖe gbe geɖe me wu le xexeame
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Gɔmeɖeɖedɔ si wowɔ ƒe geɖe, to subɔsubɔdɔ ƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ siwo dzi woka ɖo la dzi, tu nudzraɖoƒe si me gbe akpe geɖe ƒe gbeɖiɖiwo le, be amewo nado go Yesu ƒe ŋutinya le gbe si ka wo dzi wu la me.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Gbe siwo dzi woka ɖo la tsɔtsɔ yi mɔnu yeyewo me
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Míele ale si wogblɔa nyanyui ŋutinyawo le nutatawo me la gbugbɔm wɔm yeye, eye míele gɔmeɖeɖe siwo dzi woka ɖo la tsɔm kpe ɖe mɔnu yeyewo ŋu be gbedasi la nate ŋu ayi afisiafi le mɔnuwo, dekɔnuwo kple sikirinwo dzi.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Ewu nudzraɖoƒe ko. Dɔwɔha si dɔ la kplɔna.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project nye dɔwɔha si le xexeame godoo, si me gɔmeɖelawo, nyatakakamɔnuwo ŋuti aɖaŋudzelawo, nuŋɔŋlɔ ɖɔɖɔlawo kple nuwɔlawo le, eye wole ƒe geɖe ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ me nuteƒekpɔkpɔ trɔm wòzu dɔwɔnuwo na ame siwo wɔa nusrɔ̃lawo le afisiafi.
Mission.nextStepsTitle: Afɔɖeɖe Si Kplɔe Ɖo ƒe Mɔnu
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Edoa ka kpɔlawo kple mɔnukpɔkpɔ siwo dze ƒã le woƒe gbɔgbɔmezɔzɔ me, eye wòkpena ɖe wo ŋu be woaɖe afɔ si kplɔe ɖo ayi hadomegbenɔnɔ, Ŋɔŋlɔ Kɔkɔe, alo dɔ la me.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Kristotɔwo ƒe nudzraɖoƒe gã si me video, film kple dɔwɔnu akpe geɖewo le le gbe geɖewo me, na subɔsubɔdɔ kple nyanyuigbɔgblɔ le xexeame godoo.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Videowo dzikpɔkpɔ, nuwo mama, kpɔlawo ƒe kadodo kple nyatakakawo dzodzro, siwo wowɔ be woakpe ɖe subɔsubɔdɔwo ŋu be woaɖo ame geɖe gbɔ nyuie.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu nàtu {accent} ƒe dɔwɔnuwo na dɔ la
Mission.inviteBody: Míele dɔwɔlawo, nuwɔlawo kple kpeɖeŋutɔwo kpem be woakpɔ mɔ do ŋgɔ. Dzro dɔwɔnu yeyewo kpɔ gbã, gblɔ wò susu, eye nàkpe ɖe mía ŋu míawɔ nu siwo sɔ na dɔ la ŋutɔŋutɔ.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Eʋua Jesus Film ƒe dɔ ŋuti axa
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Eʋua Jesus Film ƒe dɔ ŋuti axa le ŋgɔyiyi ƒe ɖoɖo ƒe akpa
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Eʋua dodokpɔlawo ƒe ŋkɔŋlɔƒe le internet dzi
